whatRagPqActuallyNeeds: A regulatory-guidance corpus the gold questions can be answered from, ingested into a store the pipeline actually reads, with embeddings and pinned document revisions. Candidates: vault.document_chunks under a named eval organization via server/services/vault/document-chunking.service.ts:250, or rag_chunks/rag_documents with organization_id. It must cover ICH Q1A(R2), Q2, Q3A(R2), Q7, Q8, E2A, E6(R2), E9/E9(R1), M4, 21 CFR 312.23, FDA orphan/Breakthrough/510(k)/BLA-NDA material, EMA PIP guidance and EU MDR. CT.gov ingestion into csr_reports/csr_details does not supply this.

run-eval.ts needs a tenant/corpus scope: new CLI flags (for example --org-uuid for the vault, or --corpus rag_chunks --org-id) threaded through buildQueryParams (run-eval.ts:96-108). Without them searchVaultSimilar returns [] (advancedRAGPipeline.ts:973-982) regardless of corpus contents.

Rewrite the gold set: populate expectedSourceIds with real ids from that corpus, matching what run-eval compares (s.documentId || s.id, run-eval.ts:166). Expand it to the 30-50 items the file itself requires (gold-dataset.json:2), version and hash it the way run-pq does the doc-quality bank, and fix the stale '12-item' README text (README.md:18, 70).

Fail closed on unscored metrics. When hit-rate or faithfulness scores 0 items, the run should report NOT_EXECUTED/INCOMPLETE instead of a numeric 0 read as FAIL (run-eval.ts:198-221; rag-metrics.ts:31-34).

Attribution verification: return the served model from queryWithGeneration (AIResponse.model, aiProviderRouter.ts:120-122, is dropped at advancedRAGPipeline.ts:1646-1651) and from the judge call. Verify both per item with servedModelMatches, as run-pq.ts:211-213 does. Refuse the 'usable as PQ evidence' attestation (run-eval.ts:226-230) when the generator never ran because retrieval was empty.

Integrate rag into the PQ: add a rag result type and field on PqRecord (pq-verdict.ts:244-263) and a rag phase in run-pq.ts. Add ragFindings in computeVerdict (pq-verdict.ts:201-241) that measures minHitRate and minFaithfulness over verified items and, mirroring extractionFindings (:150-172), returns INCOMPLETE when rag is required and executable but ran nothing. Without this, setting executable:true is fail-open.

Pin or otherwise control the auxiliary retrieval models (HyDE and multi-query in rag-retrieval-strategies.ts:72-73 and 98-99, plus the reranker), or run the PQ with strategy 'basic', so the retrieval set is reproducible and attributable.

Correct pq-protocol.json:34 notExecutableReason and ga-readiness-report.mjs:768-769, 843, 845 to name the real blockers. Fix the gate function names, and update the stale test comment at run-pq.test.ts:128.

Outside a session scope the tenant assertion stands down, so the result is a silent empty list, not an error. The cause of 'retrieval scores 0 items' is therefore the harness, not ENABLE_CORPUS_INGESTION.

points.statement: The PQ verdict engine and runner have no RAG path. The rag component's only effect on the verdict is the 'cannot execute' INCOMPLETE reason. Flipping executable to true without new code would drop rag from the verdict entirely, letting a PQ pass without RAG ever running, which is the failure mode the file warns about for extraction. Making rag 'executable' therefore requires code in this repository.
points.evidence: server/eval/pq/pq-verdict.ts:201-205 (computeVerdict takes protocol, generation, extraction only), :92-96 (unexecutableComponents is the only place rag is read), :150-153 (the warning for a required component that 'ran no task'), :244-263 (PqRecord has no rag field). server/eval/pq/run-pq.ts:243 (computeVerdict(protocol, generation, extraction)). run-pq.ts has no rag phase; its only rag references are comments at :89.

points.statement: The claim is repeated verbatim in the GA readiness dashboard. The D4 PQ row's unblock text therefore sends operators to CT.gov ingestion, and its own comment says it quotes the reason so that no session 'goes looking for the code', steering sessions away from the code that has to be written.
points.evidence: server/eval/pq/pq-protocol.json:34. scripts/ops/ga-readiness-report.mjs:766-769 (comment: 'rag's remaining blocker is a corpus that was never ingested, and a session that cannot see that goes looking for the code'), :771-784 (quotes notExecutableReason), :808-810 (D4 unblock), :835-845 ('Precedent corpus ingestion sweep' row).

whatRagPqActuallyNeeds: A regulatory-guidance corpus in a store that ragRouter reads, holding the texts the gold set asks about: ICH Q1A(R2), E6, E9(R1), Q3A(R2), Q7, Q8, Q2, M4, E2A; 21 CFR 312.23 and the orphan threshold; the EU MDR CER; the PIP rules; 510(k) substantial equivalence; Breakthrough Therapy. Load it into vault.document_chunks for a named eval organization with ana.vault_chunking on, or into rag_chunks, and check redistribution terms for each source. ClinicalTrials.gov ingestion (csr_reports/csr_details) does not supply this.

Tenant and corpus flags on run-eval (e.g. --org-uuid, --corpus, and --org-id for rag_chunks), forwarded through buildQueryParams (server/eval/rag/run-eval.ts:96-108). Without them the vault arm returns [] (advancedRAGPipeline.ts:973-982) whatever the corpus holds. Add a test that fails when the tenant is dropped.

The gold set grown from the 20-item seed to 30-50 items, with expectedSourceIds filled from real chunk ids in that corpus, so minHitRate has any scored items. Version and hash it the way run-pq records goldBankSha256.

Zero scored items reported as not-evaluated or INCOMPLETE rather than as a metric of 0. Today mean([]) = 0 (rag-metrics.ts:31-32) makes a missing gold set read as a retrieval failure, and a no-retrieval run read as faithfulness 0.

A RAG phase in run-pq.ts and a ragFindings step in pq-verdict.ts. It needs its own result type with hit, faithfulness, servedModel and judge fields; INCOMPLETE when nothing is scorable; minHitRate and minFaithfulness measured only over verified tasks; results stored in PqRecord. Only then may pq-protocol.json set rag.executable to true. Flipping the flag alone would drop rag from the verdict.

The served model surfaced from queryWithGeneration through RagRouterResult (resolvedModel), or the RAG generation routed through gateway.evaluateModel, so PQ rule 4 (servedModelVerified) can be applied to RAG answers. A pinned judge that differs from the generator is already enforced (run-eval.ts:73-85).

verify-rag-corpus.mjs, or an eval preflight, that reports the specific store and organization the RAG PQ will read, with a non-zero exit on an empty eval corpus. It does not currently count csr_reports/csr_details, and those tables are irrelevant to RAG anyway.
Correct notExecutableReason in pq-protocol.json:34 and the D4 unblock text in ga-readiness-report.mjs:808-810 and :845 so they no longer say CT.gov ingestion is the only, operational blocker.
Owner approval of pq-protocol.json (status 'draft' at :6). This is a separate existing precondition for any PASS (pq-verdict.ts:231-238).
